name: Windows DHCP scope utilization warning
notes: Uses a hand-written JOIN (adv_query) instead of the visual builder: LibreNMS resolves table joins from a static core schema snapshot that our dhcp_scopes table isn't part of, so a plain builder condition on dhcp_scopes.* silently drops the device_id join and cross-matches every device against every scope in the database. See CHANGELOG.
adv_query: SELECT * FROM devices JOIN dhcp_scopes ON dhcp_scopes.device_id = devices.device_id WHERE devices.device_id = ? AND dhcp_scopes.percent_in_use >= 80 AND dhcp_scopes.percent_in_use < 95 AND devices.status = 1 AND devices.disabled = 0 AND devices.ignore = 0

name: Windows DHCP server not responding (no ACKs)
notes: DHCP ACK rate has dropped to zero while the device is up.

name: Windows DHCP PSU API unreachable
notes: Device responds to ICMP but its PowerShell Universal API is not answering. Requires two consecutive failed polls so a single transient blip (after the poller's own retry) does not flap.

name: Windows DHCP scope high bad-address rate
notes: Per-scope bad/conflict address percentage is >= 10%. Only meaningful when the 'Monitor declined addresses' setting is enabled; inert otherwise since bad_addresses stays 0. Uses a hand-written JOIN (adv_query) instead of the visual builder: LibreNMS resolves table joins from a static core schema snapshot that our dhcp_scopes table isn't part of, so a plain builder condition on dhcp_scopes.* silently drops the device_id join and cross-matches every device against every scope in the database. See CHANGELOG.
adv_query: SELECT * FROM devices JOIN dhcp_scopes ON dhcp_scopes.device_id = devices.device_id WHERE devices.device_id = ? AND dhcp_scopes.bad_percent >= 10 AND devices.status = 1 AND devices.disabled = 0 AND devices.ignore = 0

name: Windows DHCP high NACK ratio
notes: Server-level NACK ratio (rejected of total acks+nacks) >= 5%. Fires immediately on the first poll meeting the threshold, without debounce.
